key_insight: The paper introduces a fully symmetric, structure-preserving discretization for N-phase incompressible Navier--Stokes--Cahn--Hilliard mixtures that works for arbitrary density ratios while exactly preserving key conservation laws and energy dissipation.
engineering_relevance: This gives multiphase flow simulators a thermodynamically consistent numerical framework for complex interfacial dynamics without privileging a reference phase, improving robustness across many-fluid systems.
method: Build a fully discrete N-phase NSCH scheme with symmetric treatment of all phases.
Enforce exact phase volume, phase mass, total volume, and total mass conservation.
Preserve the volume-saturation constraint and a discrete energy-dissipation law at each time step.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports numerical verification of the structure-preserving properties and robustness on representative multiphase flow problems.
watch_item: The method is structure-preserving by design, but practical performance will still depend on solving the resulting fully discrete system efficiently for large N and high density contrasts.
paper_title: Symmetric structure-preserving discretization of N-phase incompressible fluid mixtures with arbitrary density ratios
